name: Doraji
description: Bitter white root, blanched and seasoned — also a cough medicine.

tcm.note: Jie geng is neutral, opens the lung and expels phlegm — a standard cough drug.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; katu and read as ushna.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with the pungent roots.

nutrition.highlight: a side dish, and a cough medicine
